sentences.en: The building will be made of concrete on a steel framework.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑将以钢筋作为框架，用混凝土建造。

sentences.en: The framework of the new building is progressively appearing.
sentences.zh: 新大楼的框架正在逐步显现出来。

sentences.en: The various theoretical frameworks have failed to adequately explain this phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 各种理论体系未能充分解释这一现象。
